# Vendored QR generator

`qrcode.mjs`: qrcode-generator **2.0.4**, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license (copyright and license URL preserved in the source). Obtained from the npm package `qrcode-generator@2.0.4` on September 24, 2026.

Primary source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Tags are generated entirely in the browser. Asset URLs are not transmitted to a QR service.
